about: bigger guardian looks (4x4, 8-frame walk, 4-frame idle) painted with PixelLab over the frames of our own guardian looks (big_bosses.py). Raw results are not in git; the sheets are (art_import/big_bosses/).

looks.description: void spectre lord in violet lightning, 8-frame walk and 4-frame idle on its own 4x4 frames
